definitions.explanation: Water droplets scattered when something hits a surface of water, or spray from waves, waterfalls, or fountains.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}しぶき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: A splash of water went up.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{水|みず}しぶき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing in the pool, splashing water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{滝|たき}→滝：02219_taki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{水|みず}しぶき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちよかった→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: When I went near the waterfall, the spray hit my face and it felt refreshing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) + しぶき (splash, spray). しぶき alone can mean splash or spray in general, while {水|みず}しぶき specifically refers to water spray. Often written in hiragana rather than with kanji ({飛沫|しぶき}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水|みず}しぶき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: a splash goes up
- {水|みず}しぶき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to send up a splash
- {水|みず}しぶき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to get splashed
- {水|みず}しぶき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to be showered with spray

SIMILAR WORDS:
- しぶき: splash, spray — more general, not limited to water
- ⟦{飛沫|ひまつ}→飛沫：29069_himatsu⟧: droplets, spray — more formal/scientific
- {波|なみ}しぶき: sea spray — specifically from waves
